detail: Tenant maintenance blocked actual row and object writes; another tenant continued writing; authenticated worker completed and verified archive.
Even a tenant administrator could not overwrite/delete a verified file or self-attest a safety archive; server-only finalization RPC denied to end-user JWT.
Viewer, foreign tenant and anonymous callers cannot create/read/download/restore/delete archives; private snapshot and foreign provisioning denied.
Preview simulated a real update then rolled back; audited version restored through business triggers; forged tenant and direct history mutation denied.
Server verified archive provided a record version authorized for point recovery; ordinary business guards remained active.
External ZIP checksum and tenant manifest were enforced by actual server functions; a deliberately invalid own-tenant relation was staged for rollback verification.
A real foreign-key failure rolled back all tenant deletions/inserts; foreign tenant unchanged, failed run recorded and ordinary writes resumed.
Authorized removal deleted an unreferenced file and metadata; the last verified archive remained protected.
A simulated abandoned worker lease expired; authenticated recovery marked the job failed and released tenant writes.
Tampered JWT rejected by local gateway/Auth; all three real scheduler routes reject execution while disabled.
